title: Provenance and source references
description: Where a fact or record came from and when it was observed. Provenance requires a stable source identity (source_kind plus source_id) and an observation time; it may carry a content digest of the exact observed artifact and a bounded confidence. Provenance never embeds raw captured content, page HTML, or secret values — it references sources by identifier and digest only.

sourceKind.title: Source kind
sourceKind.description: Closed set of source families. Additive growth follows the enum evolution rules in urn:japp:schema:common:enum-token:v1.

contentDigest.title: Content digest
contentDigest.description: SHA-256 digest of the exact observed artifact, rendered as sha256:<64 lowercase hex digits>.

source_id.description: Stable identifier of the source entity (for example a document, capture, or import record).

observed_at.description: Instant the source content was observed, always UTC.

confidence.description: Producer confidence that the referenced source supports the derived value.
